title: AvailabilityRange

external_id.description: A user-configured identifier for this object within the menu. External IDs must be unique across all menu entities of this type. Any availability range that shares this `external_id` will be overwritten.

name.description: The display name for this availability, which will be shown internally and externally.

start_date.description: The date and time when this override begins.

end_date.description: The date and time when this override ends.

description: Definitions of time ranges during a year when one or more menu items may be available.
